## 👤 Member Details

&lt;!-- Replace the placeholder values below with your actual information --&gt;

- **Name:** Your Full Name
- **GitHub:** @your-github-username
- **Batch:** YYYY-YYYY (e.g., 2024-2028)
- **Department:** &lt;!-- Select one: AI/ML | DSA & CP | Emerging Tech | Web Development | Event Management --&gt;
- **Role:** &lt;!-- Select one: Member | Lead | Co-Lead | Core Team | Alumni --&gt;
- **Skills:** React, Node.js, Python (top 3-5)
- **LinkedIn:** linkedin.com/in/your-username (optional)
- **Portfolio:** https://your-site.com (optional)
- **Bio:** Short 1-2 line bio about yourself

## ✅ Checklist

Before submitting, please confirm:

- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] I have filled in all required fields in `members.json`
- [ ] My GitHub username is correct
- [ ] My department matches one of: `aiml`, `dsa`, `emerging-tech`, `webdev`, `event-management`
- [ ] My batch format is `YYYY-YYYY`
- [ ] I have replaced the template member (if this is the first real member)
- [ ] I have run `python scripts/validate.py` locally and it passes
- [ ] I have run `python scripts/generate_readme.py` to update README.md (optional — CI will do this)
